changelog:
Initial release — easily pick and send local reaction GIFs by tag.

- Lets you select reaction GIFs by emotional tag (e.g. celebration, salute) from a local library.
- Avoids broken image links by storing all GIFs locally and never using external CDNs.
- Simple Python script provides tag-based search, listing, and verification of GIFs.
- Includes setup and sample GIF downloader script; no API keys or accounts required.
- Designed for reliable, hand-curated in-session media responses.
summary: Select and send local reaction GIFs by tag — pat-on-back, celebration, salute, facepalm, etc.
